business_problem: Citi wanted to modernize internal audit so thousands of auditors could review documents, assess risk and surface anomalies faster than was possible with manual methods.
solution_summary: Citi partnered with IBM to build a unified audit intelligence platform around IBM Watson Discovery, IBM Cloud Pak for Data and IBM OpenPages. The platform introduces AI, natural language processing, analytics and machine learning into the audit lifecycle so documentation review and risk assessment no longer depend on purely manual effort. Watson Discovery handles document analysis and search, Cloud Pak for Data provides the broader data and AI environment, and OpenPages operationalizes risk, governance and audit workflows. IBM’s data science and Expert Labs teams helped identify high-value use cases and integrate the components into Citi’s internal-audit operating model. In practice, auditors can use AI-based control scoring, NLP-driven document analysis and anomaly detection to move from large collections of audit material to prioritized insights, improving the quality and speed of governance decisions while reducing routine investigative work.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Discovery
solution_components.role: Analyzes audit documentation and supports NLP-driven search and review across large audit corpora.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Pak for Data
solution_components.role: Provides the data and AI platform used to build and manage Citi’s audit intelligence workloads.

solution_components.name: IBM OpenPages
solution_components.role: Operationalizes risk, audit and governance processes around the insights generated by the platform.

data_flow: Audit documents and related risk data are ingested into Watson Discovery and Cloud Pak for Data, where AI and NLP derive control and anomaly insights that flow into OpenPages for audit, governance and risk management workflows.
business_outcome: Citi reduced manual audit effort, improved visibility into risk signals and created a reusable platform that has already delivered large time savings across early audit use cases.
architecture_clues: Built as a unified AI-powered audit platform
Combines analytics, NLP and machine learning in the audit lifecycle
Supported by IBM Data Science and Expert Labs teams
evidence_quotes: Citi selected three IBM solution; IBM Watson® Discovery, IBM Cloud Pak® for Data and IBM® OpenPages®.
These solutions introduced advanced analytics, AI, machine learning and NLP into every stage of the audit lifecycle.
The first few use cases that include AI-based control scoring and NLP-powered document analysis have saved hundreds of thousands of hours.
